aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misgroups distinct lot and machine-repair comparisons and includes a spurious measurement outcome.
issues: Changed factor lumps separate lot, machine assy, and repair conditions into one comparison.
Machine assy after-repair rows are compared to Normal C2 instead of machine assy 1/2 baselines.
Rows 31, 33, 35, 38, and 39 are omitted despite relevant results or conclusions.
Measurement outcome is derived from header/defect-count columns and is not a true measurement domain.
Evidence cites row 14, while visible header context is row 13 and row 14 is not substantiated.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Test Yoke Class1 be included as a separate follow-up condition or excluded?
correctionPlan: Split changed factors into lot C2/E2 comparison and machine assy before/after repair comparison.
Pair machine assy 1 and 2 baselines with their own after-repair 1st and 2nd results.
Add omitted result rows and conclusion rows as evidence.
Remove the measurement outcome or reclassify it as defect-count table data.
Replace unsupported row 14 citation with supported header/result citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations exist partly but are insufficient and misgrouped; add direct header, result, and conclusion rows.
